Nunca hay un fotograma entero en memoria: There is never a whole frame in memory: the screen is drawn in 15 strips of 32 columns. The two cores split each strip, left half and right half, in internal RAM, while DMA sends the previous strip to the panel.
Se repite la misma escena quitando una c: The same scene, replayed with one thing removed each time. In gotico, blending the two moonbeams on the fly ate 13 ms a frame: now they come pre-painted into the background, and the game went from 31 to 60 fps.

El motor, los ejemplos, las herramientas: The engine, examples, tools and this site were written in conversation with Claude Code: every idea was tried in the simulator, measured on the board and corrected based on what the board showed.
The art, generated and made to fit.
Los aspectos que lo necesitan (Neo Geo,: The looks that call for it (Neo Geo, CPS2, 32-bit) use AI-generated images. The engine's tools cut them out, scale them to the right height, split them into frames and reduce them to the console's palette. The low-res looks are drawn with code.
Cada ejemplo tiene un guion que lo juega: Every example has a script that plays it automatically. On the computer, it checks each frame's checksum against the stored one; on the board, it logs the fps every second. Optimisations don't change a single pixel.
El código tiene licencia MIT; el arte, e: The code is MIT; the examples' art, sound and videos are CC0. Take it, change it, build your own console.

A clean clone of the repository, one request at a time and no questions answered: Codex read AGENTS.md, built the engine, followed the recipe for the look and wrote a script that plays its game, iterating until it passed. Each game was then measured on the console, running that script. Codex 0.155 with gpt-6-sol, medium reasoning. (The requests were written in Spanish and are translated here.)
Tres encargos: el juego (4 min 41 s); el: Three requests: the game (4 min 41 s), its AI-generated art (10 min 8 s; it then ran at 30 fps), and getting it to 60 fps on the console with its own ground layer (3 min 45 s). No touch-ups by hand.
Un goblin original para un beat 'em up d: An original goblin enemy for a fantasy beat-em-up: small, wiry and hunched, green skin, huge pointed ears, a ragged brown loincloth, a rusty curved dagger. Full body, facing left. Style: a mid-1990s arcade sprite, crisp hard pixel edges, a bold dark outline, about 15 colours. Transparent background.
Las herramientas del motor quitan el fon: The engine's tools remove the background, split the frames, bring them to the same scale with their feet on the same line, and reduce them to 15 colours. Then each one is checked by eye.
Cada punto es un segundo de partida en l: Each point is one second of play on the board, from the performance line logged every second while a script plays the game. Dashed: the first measurement; solid: today's. The first second loads the scene and doesn't count in the figures.
